summary: Narrow shaded lane beside a school; houses 15-25 m across, little room to pull off.
reasons: School building and trees on this side

drivers.seclusion: School building and trees behind the kerb; nearest house 15 m away at 23 m along, further houses 28 m and more at this end.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed narrow lane with no clear shoulder beside it; a van may sit partly in the lane.
drivers.traffic: Light local traffic, with school and soccer club use nearby.
drivers.convention: No parked cars seen on this stretch; 2P signs apply Mon-Fri 8 am-4 pm only.

flags: Steep: about 5% rise at the best section; max 10% near the end
Room to pull off is tight
School and soccer club activity nearby
sun_shade: Heavily shaded by tree canopy from the east and north at the best section; school building shades the north.

best_section.where: North side of Campus Street under the trees, near the junction with the main street
